text:
deploy-bot: Deploy finished to canary (v3.12.0). running post-deploy smoke + synth checks. logs: https://ci.internal/r/1719019999

alex: seeing p95 spike on synthetic kvprobe in eu-west, started ~1719019970. p50 fine.

maria: also small auth-check 5xx bump on synth probe, ~0.8% -> 2.6% over 2m. not huge but correlated with kv p95.

kyle: can you paste the probe sample?

alex:
```
probe: kvprobe-eu-west
window: 2024-10-12T14:12:00Z - 14:15:00Z
p95: 1.6s -> 3.8s
error_rate: 0.8% -> 2.5%
requests: 1200
```

anya: hmm looks like fanout to embed-worker pool spiked; some hosts reported GC pressure and one OOM kill ~1719019905 in eu-west-2. logs: /links/host-logs/hn-42

sre-oncall: thanks — correlating with infra metrics now. prelim check: no infra-wide CPU spike, but a small subset of embed-workers restarted.

release-manager: do we want to rollback or hold? status on canary traffic?

deploy-bot: Canary traffic currently at 30%.

kyle: proposal: hold further rollout, reduce canary to 10%, route new canary traffic to fallback model-variant v3.11.5, and pin v3.12.0 from automatic rollouts until triage completes. not a full rollback yet.

maria: +1 to hold and pin. we should avoid a disruptive rollback if it's localized.

anya: agreed. i'll open a short runbook for embed-worker pod restart cascade and start a shallow hotpatch: bump JVM heap on affected hosts and drain/restart one host at a time.

sre-oncall: executing commands to reduce canary traffic now.

deploy-bot: Canary traffic reduced to 10% ✅

release-manager: pin request: regions eu-west, eu-central pinned to v3.11.5 until next-green. I'll annotate the release notes.

deploy-bot: Pin applied for eu-west, eu-central. routing fallback to v3.11.5 enabled.

alex: after routing change, p95 on kvprobe down to ~1.2s in latest 2m. error_rate back to 0.9%. monitoring for 15m.

kyle: good signal. keep watchlist for 60m. if stable, proceed with staged rollout + gradual traffic increase (30% -> 60% -> 100%) with 15m soak between steps.

maria: I'll add a note to release notes and create a short postmortem checklist if this resurfaces.

anya: running host restarts now, doing rolling one-by-one. will report if any OOMs repeat.

sre-oncall: adding a temporary alert rule to catch embed-worker restarts and KV p95 > 2s across canary for next 2 hours.

release-manager: thanks team. action items: (1) triage host OOMs (anya), (2) monitor synth watchlist 60m (alex/maria), (3) don't increase rollout until green (release-manager). Update in 30m or sooner if regression. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

alex: update @30m: metrics stable at 60m mark, no further OOMs, p95 steady. recommend proceed to 30% in 15m.

deploy-bot: scheduled staged increase to 30% at 1719021250 (in 15m) pending manual confirm.

release-manager: I'll wait for manual +1 before each step. good triage work, everyone.

kyle: we should add an automated pre-rollout check to detect embed-worker heap pressure for future releases — follow-up RFC next sprint.

anya: noted. filing a short RFC and linking runbook edits.

maria: leaving a trace note in the release changelog: "post-deploy: canary-held due to localized embed-worker restarts; pinned routing to v3.11.5 in eu regions; rolling host fixes applied; staged rollout resumed after 60m watch."

release-manager: closing thread for now, will reopen if regressions.
